# Gevurah Pass — Realistic Scope

Keep this pass presentation-focused. No MiniMax contract or persistence changes unless runtime inspection proves a dependency.

Likely targets after inspection:
- one or two existing Create view modules only if structural markup needs a small full-file rewrite;
- new small CSS modules loaded last through `DirectorStyles.js`;
- one focused browser smoke regression measuring reduced visual fragmentation and first-screen geometry.

Avoid:
- new dependencies;
- canvas/WebGL;
- continuous JS animation loops;
- pointer-tracking effects;
- layout animation;
- extra always-visible education;
- hidden essential controls.

Performance budget:
- transforms/opacity/background-position only for ambient motion;
- no animated blur;
- no giant box-shadow pulses;
- no additional network assets.
